doc: Directions at the 9x17 CORNERS of the texels (half a texel off the centers): each sample is the mean of the four surrounding texels, with longitude wrapped (corner column 0 at -pi and column 16 at +pi both average the last and the first texel columns) and latitude clamped (corner row 0 at the pole averages row 0 with itself, row 8 row 7). The poles here are lat = +-pi/2 with x, y ~ 6e-17, not exact zeros. float64.
